description: This file defines the 'Concatenate' class, which provides static methods for text concatenation, joining, and repetition, including implementations for CONCATENATE, TEXTJOIN, and REPT functions in a PHP spreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Concatenate
classes.description: A class offering static methods for string concatenation, joining, and repetition in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: CONCATENATE
methods.description: Concatenates multiple arguments into a single string, flattening arrays and handling errors and string length limits.

methods.name: TEXTJOIN
methods.description: Joins multiple text items with a specified delimiter, with options to ignore empty cells and handle array inputs.

methods.name: builtinREPT
methods.description: Repeats a string a specified number of times, with error handling and support for array inputs.
